reply: Closed 21:45 CST Nov 12 by triage: no longer needed. Batch 104 merged at 14:43 CST today (its pull request, read on GitHub at 21:38 CST), so there is no rerun left to choose.
short: Batch 104 runs again until express is ready
title: Batch 104 runs again now, and an express change cancels it only when ready
